title: RfRecordList
description: MyDefence internal and subject to change without notice. Current and completed RF segment recording operations. A failed recording is included in exactly one rfRecordList broadcast, then forgotten without a separate removal update. Subsequent broadcasts and rfRecordGetList responses omit it; clients that only poll may miss failures.

recordingId.description: Unique ID for this logical recording operation.

deviceIds.description: Devices requested for this recording operation.

status.description: inProgress: recording or archive creation is ongoing. complete: all requested device transfers completed and an archive is available. partial: an archive is available, but at least one device transfer was incomplete or failed. failed: no archive could be published, either because no device produced usable data or because processing failed. A failed entry is broadcast once, then removed from memory without another update and is not persisted; errorInfo describes the failure.

bytesTransferred.description: Bytes received from devices so far (updated at most once per second while inProgress), or total bytes for a completed/partial recording. Always 0 for failed recordings.

threatType.description: Type of threat that triggered the recording. Set for recType `threat`. Number refers to `id` in DeviceMiscellaneous:droneList.

createdTimeStamp.description: Timestamp of when recording was created

filePath.description: Path to the recording archive for complete or partial recordings. Can be fetched from https://<argos-ip:28230>/<filePath>

errorInfo.description: Reason a recording failed. Present on the single broadcast containing the failed entry; the entry is then forgotten and omitted from subsequent list broadcasts and responses.
